text: Credit teams still piece covenant analysis together from documents,
spreadsheets, and screenshots.
The numbers may be right, but the trail is hard to verify.
Assay makes every figure evidence-linked and every payment bounded by policy.
This is the covenant operations workspace: borrowers, facilities,
runs, approvals, and audit evidence in one view.
The workspace is synthetic by design,
with no public signup and no autonomous credit decision.
Inside a completed run,
Assay shows the confidential inference attestation,
the financial snapshot, and the covenant calculation.
Baseline leverage is 3.07 times against a 3.50 times threshold,
with stress cases beside it.
Deterministic code performs the arithmetic.
A zero-knowledge proof verifies the private inputs,
and a credit manager records the approval.
Privacy is enforced before reasoning.
Documents are redacted with Presidio,
encrypted in private storage under a borrower-specific key,
and tokenized.
Only structured, extracted data reaches the reasoning model.
Audit events are hash-chained and signed.
For market context, Assay's planner proposed a paid provider,
and the analyst selected LoneStar Oracle.
LoneStar returned a real x402 requirement: 0.05 USDC on Arc Mainnet,
standard exact, EIP-3009.
Assay checked provider, endpoint, recipient, network, asset, amount,
budget, expiry, and idempotency before signing.
One payment was authorized, confirmed by a provider receipt,
and the Apple fundamentals were stored as encrypted evidence.
On Arc Mainnet,
the explorer shows a successful transferWithAuthorization of 0.05
USDC from Assay's payer wallet to the verified merchant.
The wallet moved from 0.93 to 0.88 USDC.
The evidence record carries the source URL, retrieval time,
a SHA-256 hash of the raw response, validation status,
and the payment intent.
Price, analyst target, market cap, P/E, EPS,
and the 52-week range are shown as financial facts, not model prose.
Assay separates policy approval, payment settlement, calculation,
proof, and human approval.
A timeout becomes reconciliation required, never an automatic retry.
The audit chain verifies all thirty-two events for this borrower,
including the payment and evidence retrieval.
Assay: evidence-linked analysis, bounded agentic payments,
and an audit trail you can verify.
The model interprets.
Code calculates.
Cryptography proves.
A human approves.
